No network operations, data exfiltration, or dynamic code evaluation occur during sourcing.

The use of a fixed version tag in the source URL and a valid checksum indicates good hygiene. While the source is over HTTPS from a trusted project domain, even if it weren't, no download occurs during `--printsrcinfo`. Therefore, sourcing this PKGBUILD poses no risk.
</details>
